# superset_charts (Data Source)

Lists the charts that match every filter that is set, for example every chart of a dashboard to send with `superset_report`, or every chart of a dataset. Without filters, every chart. The list is ordered by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_dashboard" "sales" {
  slug = "sales"
}

# Every chart placed on the sales dashboard.
data "superset_charts" "on_sales" {
  dashboard_id = data.superset_dashboard.sales.id
}

# Every table chart of a dataset.
data "superset_charts" "tables" {
  datasource_id = superset_dataset.sales.id
  viz_type      = "table"
}

resource "superset_report" "sales_charts" {
  for_each = { for chart in data.superset_charts.on_sales.charts : chart.id => chart }

  name     = "Sales: ${each.value.name}"
  type     = "Report"
  crontab  = "0 9 * * 1"
  chart_id = each.value.id
  recipients = [
    { type = "Email", target = "sales@example.com" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dashboard_id` (Number) Keep the charts placed on the dashboard with this id.
- `datasource_id` (Number) Keep the charts of the dataset with this id.
- `owner_id` (Number) Keep the charts owned by the user with this id.
- `tag` (String) Keep the charts that carry the tag with exactly this name.
- `viz_type` (String) Keep the charts with exactly this visualization type, for example `table`.

### Read-Only

- `charts` (Attributes List) The charts that match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--charts))
- `ids` (List of Number) Identifiers of the charts, in the order of the list.

<a id="nestedatt--charts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `charts`

Read-Only:

- `datasource_id` (Number) Identifier of the dataset of the chart.
- `datasource_type` (String) Type of the dataset of the chart, usually `table`.
- `description` (String) Description of the chart.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the chart.
- `name` (String) Name of the chart.
- `url` (String) Path of the chart in Superset.
- `viz_type` (String) Visualization type of the chart.
